newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Zhenhai delays shutdown of CDU to early April.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhai delays shutdown of CDU to early April.

text.p: China's Zhenhai Refining & Chemical Co Ltd has delayed the shutdown of a 100,000-barrel-per-day crude unit by over a month to the first half of April, a source close to the company said on Thursday.
"We have postponed the shutdown of the big crude unit to first half April," the source said.
He added that the company may postpone the maintenance again if the current tight market conditions continue.
Zhenhai originally planned to shutdown the crude unit and a 30,000-bpd fluid catalytic cracker for one month in March.
In the second stage of the maintenance programme, Zhenhai will shutdown a smaller 60,000-bpd crude unit with a 20,000-bpd hydrocracker also for one month after the first crude unit restarts.
Currently China is facing high international product prices and it is more profitable for the refinery to operate at full capacity, sources said.
Earlier the source said that two years ago the refinery planned a maintenance in May but finally advanced to April because of market conditions.
But this time the company is delaying the shutdown, he said.
